instruction: Cross-check the invoices with the bank statements and identify any discrepancies. Then pull out the invoices that don't match the statements and put them in the "problematic" folder.
evidence: At step 2, the agent initiates an inefficient strategy (R4) to install software ('poppler-utils') to convert PDFs to text, hallucinating that this was 'mentioned in the instructions'. This process, along with resolving repository issues (steps 3-23) and correcting naming errors caused by misperceiving 'GES' as 'GE5' (steps 24-30), consumed the vast majority of the 50-step limit, resulting in a timeout before the agent could even begin comparing the documents.
correction: The agent should have used the pre-installed Document Viewer (Evince) to read the PDF files directly instead of attempting to install poppler-utils and convert them to text via the terminal. This would have saved over 30 steps and avoided the naming confusion caused by terminal interactions.
